name: DescribeCloudAssistantSettings

parameters.help_en: The list of service configurations to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的服务配置列表
parameters.name: setting_type

AgentUpgradeConfig.description_en: The Cloud Assistant Agent upgrade configuration

AllowedUpgradeWindow.description_en: The list of allowed upgrade time windows
AllowedUpgradeWindow.description_zh: 允许升级的时间段列表

items.description_en: The list of allowed upgrade time windows
items.description_zh: 允许升级的时间段列表

BootstrapUpgrade.description_en: Indicates whether the Cloud Assistant Agent checks for and performs updates immediately upon startup
BootstrapUpgrade.description_zh: 是否在云助手 Agent 启动时立即检查和进行更新

DisableUpgrade.description_en: Indicates whether the Cloud Assistant Agent is prohibited from checking for and performing updates
DisableUpgrade.description_zh: 是否禁止云助手 Agent 检查和进行更新

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the custom Agent upgrade configuration is enabled. If the query result is false or empty, the default behavior of attempting an upgrade every 30 minutes is retained
Enabled.description_zh: 是否开启自定义Agent升级配置。如查询结果为false或空，默认保持每30分钟尝试升级一次

TimeZone.description_en: The time zone of the allowed upgrade time windows
TimeZone.description_zh: 允许升级时间段的时区

OssDeliveryConfig.description_en: The list of OSS delivery configurations

BucketName.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket

DeliveryType.description_en:
The delivery type. Valid values:
SessionManager: session operation logs.
Invocation: task execution logs
DeliveryType.description_zh:
投递类型，可能值：
SessionManager：会话操作记录。
Invocation：任务执行记录

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether delivery to OSS is enabled

EncryptionAlgorithm.description_en:
The OSS encryption algorithm. Valid values:
AES256
SM4
EncryptionAlgorithm.description_zh:
OSS加密算法，可能值：
AES256
SM4

EncryptionKeyId.description_en: The customer master key (CMK) ID used when the encryption method is KMS
EncryptionKeyId.description_zh: 加密方式为KMS时，用户的主密钥CMK ID

EncryptionType.description_en:
The OSS encryption method. Valid values:
Inherit: Inherited from the bucket.
OssManaged: Fully managed by OSS.
KMS: KMS encryption
EncryptionType.description_zh:
OSS加密方式，可能值：
Inherit：继承 Bucket；
OssManaged：OSS 完全托管；
KMS：KMS加密

Prefix.description_en: The directory prefix of the OSS bucket

ResourceUsageConfig.description_en: The Cloud Assistant resource usage configuration

CpuLimit.description_en: The maximum CPU usage allowed for the Cloud Assistant Agent main process
CpuLimit.description_zh: 云助手Agent主进程最大允许的CPU占用限制

KeepScriptFile.description_en: Indicates whether the script file is retained in the Cloud Assistant directory after command execution is complete
KeepScriptFile.description_zh: 命令执行完成后，是否保留脚本文件到云助手目录

LogFileCountLimit.description_en: The maximum number of Cloud Assistant log files to retain
LogFileCountLimit.description_zh: 云助手日志文件的最大保存数量

LogSizeLimit.description_en: The size limit of Cloud Assistant log files
LogSizeLimit.description_zh: 云助手日志文件的大小限制

MemoryLimit.description_en: The maximum memory usage allowed for the Cloud Assistant Agent main process
MemoryLimit.description_zh: 云助手Agent主进程最大允许的内存占用限制

OverloadLimit.description_en: The maximum number of consecutive times that CPU or memory resources usage can exceed the limit. After this limit is reached, the Cloud Assistant Agent automatically stops running
OverloadLimit.description_zh: CPU或内存资源占用连续超限次数上限，达到上限后云助手Agent自动终止运行

SessionManagerConfig.description_en: The Cloud Assistant session feature configuration

SessionManagerEnabled.description_en:
The toggle for the Cloud Assistant session feature. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

Precautions:
Enabling or disabling the session feature takes effect in all regions
SessionManagerEnabled.description_zh:
云助手会话功能开关。取值范围：
true: 开启；
false: 关闭。

注意事项：
会话功能开启/关闭对全部地域生效

SlsDeliveryConfig.description_en: The list of SLS delivery configurations

DeliveryType.description_en:
The delivery type. Valid values:
SessionManager: session operation logs.
Invocation: task execution logs
DeliveryType.description_zh:
投递类型，可能值：
SessionManager：会话操作记录。
Invocation：任务执行记录

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether delivery to SLS is enabled

LogstoreName.description_en: The name of the SLS Logstore

ProjectName.description_en: The name of the SLS project
